title: Project at 3593 N. Multiview Dr. - Sarah Hunt (10 Minutes) - Discussion and possible motion to send
text:
[NEW BUSINESS- DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE MOTION]
Project at 3593 N. Multiview Dr. - Sarah Hunt (10 Minutes) - Discussion and possible motion to send
a letter. Hearing Dec. 4th. Large residence proposed with pool and extensive grading. Removal of 21
Protected Trees on approx. 5 acre parcel; 2.38 wildlife conservation easement proposed; Mitigated Neg.
Declaration issued. Brodin Residence (ENV-2021-4440-MND)
summary: The committee is deciding whether to send a letter on a proposed large home with a pool and heavy grading at 3593 N. Multiview Dr, which would remove 21 protected trees on about five acres before a December 4 hearing.
